newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah stable in slow late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah stable in slow late trading.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah was stable against the dollar in late trading on Wednesday, dealers said.
They said volume was thin in the afternoon, with operators seen keeping pressure on the dollar to boost rupiah reserves on Friday due to banks' liquidity reports.
Spot rupiah was at 2,374.00/74.25 at 0945 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,373.5/74.5. Tomorrow and today rupiah closed at 2,373.50/73.85 and 2,372.5/73.0, respectively.
One Japanese bank dealer said the market was still driven by the liquidity issue due to the upcoming celebration for the lunar new year and the Eid al-Fitr.
One-month swaps edged up to 14.00/14.75 from 13.75/14.75, two to 28.25/29.25 from 26.5/28.0, three to 39.75/40.75 from 38.5/39.5 and six to 78.0/79.5 from 78.0/80.0 points.
The central bank raised its intervention band by one point to 2,374/2,566 and the conversion band to 2,374/2,422 on Wednesday, the second depreciation this week.
The bank depreciated the rupiah by three points last week after lowering it by two points the previous week.
